name: Reading only within the final partial page of a mapped file - POSIX guarantees zero-fill
component: ground-truth pairing: the false positive the harness found
required_postconditions: bytes between the end of the file and the end of its final page read as zero, which POSIX requires of every conforming system

failure_sink.description: there is no reachable sink on a conforming host; the case reports `faulted` only if one appears, which would be a platform bug

extraction_limitations: Single-claim contract written to pair with a ground-truth case. It asserts exactly one thing so that a whole-contract verdict can be compared against a single observation without ambiguity.
x_groundtruth: cases/file_map_partial_page.c performs this read. The analyzer called it UNSUPPORTED on every sigbus host until eof_access_extent existed.
